entries.source_excerpt: Notification of activities 16. (1) A person undertaking any activity as specified in paragraphs 22(1) (a) to (c) of the Act shall give prior notification to the Board. (2) The notification required under paragraphs 22(1) (b) and (c) shall be submitted— (a) to the Director General; or (b) for the purpose in accordance with the establishment of an institutional biosafety committee under subregulation 5(1), to the Director General through an institutional biosafety committee, and shall be accompanied by a prescribed fee.

source_excerpts.text: Non-application 2. These Regulations shall not apply to— (a) products of such organisms which are pharmaceuticals and addressed by relevant international treaties or organizations, or regulated under any other written laws relating to pharmaceuticals; and (b) techniques and contained use activities in relation to living modified organisms as specified in the First Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE (regulation 2) TECHNIQUES IN RELATION TO LIVING MODIFIED ORGANISMS TO WHICH THESE REGULATIONS ARE NOT APPLICABLE ... CONTAINED USE ACTIVITIES WHICH ARE EXEMPTED FROM NOTIFICATION Item Activity 1. An activity with genetically modified Caenorhabditis elegans and Arabidopsis, unless— (a) an advantage is conferred on the organism by the genetic modification; or (b) as a result of the genetic modification, the animal is capable of secreting or producing an infectious agent, toxins or other products that can potentially cause adverse effects on living organisms.

Item Activity 2. An activity with an organism into which genetically modified somatic cells have been introduced, if— (a) the somatic cells are not capable of giving rise to infectious agents as a result of the genetic modification; and (b) the animal is not infected with a virus that is capable of recombining with the genetically modified nucleic acid in the somatic cells. 3. An activity involving a host/vector system mentioned in the Host/Vector Systems Not Regulated For Contained Use where the donor nucleic acid— (a) must be characterized and not known to alter the host range or mode of transmission, or increase the virulence, pathogenicity or transmissibility of the host or vector; ...

The exemption list for Notification includes any commercially available Host-Vector System fulfilling the criteria as specified under item 1. SECOND SCHEDULE (regulation 3) CLASSES OF ACTIVITIES INVOLVING MODERN BIOTECHNOLOGY ...
